author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: The disinflation rally has already done the easing the Fed refuses to deliver: the 10Y Treasury is 42 bps lower over 20 observations at 4.41%, VIX sits at 13.35 and DXY is down 2.52%, while Tuesday's minutes say rates must stay high and hedge-fund crowding is at a record. Positioning should therefore shift from chasing rate relief to owning margin and policy-backed earnings (AI infrastructure, off-price retail, miners, Polish banks on EU money and a strong złoty) with cheap protection, while fading housing-linked and low-end discretionary names and China property.
sources_policy: Facts come only from own-date headlines cited in the same part (exact [[nNNNN]] ids from tools/digest.py 2023-11-22) or from the 2023-11-22 writer card (completed sessions, all dated 2023-11-21; Treasury prior close 2023-11-21; crypto prior completed daily close 2023-11-21). Records with day-granular placeholder times dated 2023-11-21 were used only where the event plausibly completed before 2023-11-22 00:00 UTC (FOMC minutes, Nvidia/HP/Nordstrom after-close results, Lowe's/Abercrombie/Medtronic pre-market results, existing-home sales, Bullock speech, Polish industry/wages, EU KPO decision, Binance charges). No numeric spot-FX quotes; currency direction only from cited headlines. Exclusions n1726 and n2107 not cited. Background knowledge used only for general mechanisms.
known_ambiguities_omitted: Nvidia's after-hours share reaction to its Q3 results: no eligible headline, so no reaction is stated; card NVDA close is pre-reaction.
OpenAI leadership outcome after the Microsoft hire is not stated; only the Nov 20-21 Microsoft hire/offer headlines are used.
Binance settlement terms (amount, plea) are not stated; headlines establish only criminal charges and that CZ is now ex-CEO.
Polish headline 'Kurs dolara spadł poniżej 4 zł' (n1824) and 'Funt za mniej niż 5 zł' (n1712) and 'trades below 150 yen' (n1591) contain numeric FX levels; only direction is used.
n1735 (Money.pl, 'Wojna w Ukrainie. Parlament uchwalił budżet na rok 2024... rekordowy deficyt') is ambiguous between the Polish and Ukrainian parliaments; not used.
Italy's Moody's review outcome (n1411 is only a preview) is not stated.
Dutch election and Black Friday outcomes are treated as pending; no results asserted.
Israel-Hamas hostage-deal approval is not stated; n1527 only says release has gotten closer.
Marta Kightley (n1815) and the unnamed NBP first deputy president (n1799) may be the same person; only n1815 is used to avoid double-counting.
Kotecki's institutional role is not stated; he is attributed only by name via Rzeczpospolita (n1750).
No October China credit (new loans/TSF) release headline exists; Credit Impulse relies on sectoral-loan, yuan-financing and LPR evidence.
